AGO.note: Data centres named only as something the cable makes possible.

facts.fact: AAI says the 2Africa cable, designed for up to 180 Tbps, has operated since July 2025 and lands at Cacuaco, Luanda, where UNITEL built the landing station CLS1; the cable was inaugurated on 12 December 2025.

AGO.note: No data centre for hire stated.
